# FreeCreds

> Find California community-college courses that satisfy university transfer requirements, with optional CVC online-course filters.

## Pages

- [FreeCreds](https://freecreds.pages.dev/): Search transfer-course articulations and current or upcoming online listings.

## Sources and limitations

FreeCreds is an independent planning aid using periodically refreshed ASSIST and CVC Exchange data. Results may be delayed or incomplete. Confirm academic decisions with the relevant institutions and a counselor.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ivan-grebe/freecreds): Source code, setup instructions, tests, and issue tracking.
